title: Makerspace Network — Local badge alignment
description: One space's mapping from its own badges to network achievement definitions, with a per-competency coverage audit. This is the working document a coordinator takes to a shop manager: here is the checklist, show us where each item is covered, here are the ones you are missing. See docs/ACHIEVEMENTS.md §5.

space_id.description: Must match a record in data/spaces/.

reviewed_with.description: Who at the space walked through this. An alignment nobody at the space confirmed is a guess.

local_badge.description: The space's own name for it. Never renamed to match us — mapping is our job, not theirs.

local_badge_id.description: The space's stable machine id, e.g. a MakeHaven field_badge_text_id.

local_badge_url.description: The public criteria page, if there is one.

status.description: 'aligned' requires every critical competency covered and confirmed by the space.

claim_scope.description: How thoroughly the local badge assesses, independent of what it covers. Mirrors MakeHaven's field_badge_claim_scope — the two questions are orthogonal and a credential needs both answered.

brand_delta.description: Which brand_delta key from the achievement this space's machine corresponds to, e.g. 'sawstop'.

coverage.description: One entry per competency in the achievement. Absent entries are treated as 'unknown', which blocks 'aligned'.

where.description: Where in the space's own material — video timestamp, quiz question, checkout step.

assessment.description: What the space actually does. If weaker than the competency's min_assessment, coverage is at best 'partial'.

actions.description: What the space agreed to add. The point of the exercise: a short, concrete list, not a rewrite of their training.
